protocol.data_role: procedural mechanism development only; no natural/held-out/default claim
protocol.gate: at least80% of the SAME conditions pass the regret limit at BOTH phases; all cases valid
protocol.missing_policy: retain successes and failures; any incomplete case excludes whole-atlas positive verdict
protocol.objective: raw 0.5 mean squared RGB error; full image, no mask
protocol.pairing: family/condition; every candidate receives the same20-step recovery
protocol.prediction: local quadratic continuous; split Hessian plus exact linear donor cost; birth single-pixel proxy minus donor cost
protocol.primary: local packet selection regret versus privileged unrestricted finite oracle before and after recovery
protocol.proposal: parent-only group GN; symmetric split min-eigenvector with paid donor; residual-peak donor replacement

render_work_accounting.scope: completed cells; failed cells may have additional partial work

protocol.scoring: raw PSNR with MSEfloor1e-12; display-clamped MS-SSIM/LPIPS
protocol.secondary: search for high-activity/low-coherence cases where continuous beats every funded split
protocol.seed_role: three deterministic angle/donor-cost conditions, not independent random samples
protocol.terminal: exact20 fresh-state Adam updates per action, no best-checkpoint selection
protocol.timing: descriptive shared CPU; report proposal time and complete per-action recovery time
protocol.warmup: translation perturbation77 with two Adam steps, once per case worker
